# powerdns_record (Data Source)

Reads one RRSet.

PowerDNS has no endpoint for a single RRSet, so this reads the zone and selects from it. On a large zone that is not cheap; prefer one read and local lookups over this in a loop.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# There is no endpoint for a single RRSet, so this reads the zone and selects
# from it. On a large zone that is not cheap; prefer one powerdns_zone read and
# local lookups over this in a loop.
data "powerdns_record" "mail" {
  zone = "example.com."
  name = "example.com."
  type = "MX"
}

output "mail_exchangers" {
  value = data.powerdns_record.mail.values
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The owner name.
- `type` (String) The record type.
- `zone` (String) The zone holding the set.

### Read-Only

- `disabled` (Boolean) True when any record in the set is not served.
- `id` (String) `<zone>/<name>/<type>`.
- `ttl` (Number) Time to live, in seconds.
- `values` (List of String) The record values.
